readerCopy.body: Someone may offer you a larger possibility because of experience you usually think of as the reason you are behind. When Jupiter sextiles Chiron, a mentor, class, introduction, publication, teaching opportunity, or new role can give difficult experience somewhere useful to go. The opportunity still needs a response from you. Apply, ask the question, tell the relevant part of the story, or let the lesson you earned qualify you for something instead of automatically disqualifying you from it.
